description: Dependency freshness as reviewed MRs, not drift (issue #5). Covers the hash-pinned backend lock (backend/requirements.txt, compiled from pyproject.toml by uv) and the web npm lock (web/package-lock.json).

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Security-critical packages are exact-pinned (docs/technical/operations.md policy; Playwright precedent) — every bump, including patches, arrives as its own reviewable MR.
Group non-major backend lock updates into a single weekly MR; majors stay separate for focused review.
Group non-major web updates into a single weekly MR; majors stay separate for focused review.
